shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Only for layers that float over content: the landing's mark callout and the screener's gap tooltip.

shadows.name: outline
shadows.purpose: Strokes on inputs, outline buttons and stamps, drawn inside so they never shift layout.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focus on text fields and selects.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing curve; every transition and entrance uses it.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and selection changes on controls.

motion.name: popover
motion.purpose: Callout and suggestion list open and close, from scale(0.97).

motion.name: mark-fill
motion.purpose: Landing chart marks fill in row by row from scale(0.45).

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: Verdict stamps land once from scale(1.12) after their row fills.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: Replaces mark-fill and stamp under prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.overview:
Site of Interest reads like an independent testing lab's ratings page printed for the IDX: a table of marks per company, the method printed beside it, and every number traceable to its source. The page is paper and ink first. Color is reserved for two jobs only, interaction and verdicts, so a reader can tell a working control from a reading at a glance.

Density is that of a reference table, not a dashboard. Headlines are set heavy and tight in one family; the data below them is tabular and plain. Ornament is replaced by working marks: Harvey balls, rubber-stamp verdict boxes, and heavy ink rules that open each section. Nothing on a page is decorative if it cannot also be read.

The system refuses the fintech default of a hero, a gradient dashboard mock and three feature cards, and it refuses the earlier dark terminal look this redesign replaced.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground, near-black ink, one ultramarine, red only for flags.
One typeface, Libre Franklin, served from the app bundle, heavy for headings and tabular for numbers.
Harvey-ball marks and verdict stamps are the shared vocabulary on every page.
Sections open on a 4px ink rule; rows separate on hairlines.
Motion is brief, ease-out, and mostly confined to the landing's chart.

rules.name: The Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine means "you can act here" or "Worth a look"; red means "flag". No other hue appears, and neither is used to decorate.

rules.name: The Readable Quiet Rule
rules.body: The quietest text color still passes 4.5:1. Missing data is shown in Quiet Ink, never hidden or faded further.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number is set with tabular lining figures so columns align without boxes.

rules.name: The Wrap Before Shrink Rule
rules.body: Long names and sources wrap; type does not shrink below 11px to make them fit.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing at rest casts a shadow. Pop appears only on layers that float over content.

dos: **Do** keep the ground Cool Paper and the text Press Ink; reach for Paper Shade or Sheet White before any new color.
**Do** show every verdict with the shared marks and stamps, and every number with tabular figures.
**Do** open each major section with a 4px Press Ink rule and a heavy headline.
**Do** keep motion under 300ms with the ease-out curve (`cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)`), except the 420ms mark fill, and gate hover effects behind fine pointers.
**Do** label missing data in Quiet Ink as Not reported, Not checked or Does not apply.
donts: **Don't** use Ultramarine or Flag Red for decoration, illustration or emphasis.
**Don't** add gradients, glass, glows or resting shadows.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface or load fonts from a third-party host.
**Don't** lighten Quiet Ink below 4.5:1 on paper.
**Don't** return to the dark terminal look or the hero, dashboard mock and feature-card landing.
